metadata.title: IngreFit — AI Food Scanner for Your Goals
metadata.description: Scan a barcode or food label and get a factual, personalized 10-point fit score for your nutrition goals.

hero.title: A food scanner that asks one useful question:
hero.subtitle: Scan any barcode free, or use Premium photo recognition. IngreFit compares available facts with your goals on a clear 10-point scale.

how.title: Point, read, understand
how.subtitle: The app uses the fastest reliable source first, then asks for evidence when the database is incomplete.
how.step1Body: We check Open Food Facts for identity, ingredients, nutrition, allergens, Nutri-Score and NOVA data.
how.step2Body: Premium can read a missing package label from three photos or cautiously identify food without packaging from one photo.
how.step3Body: A deterministic 1–10 score uses only available facts and the goals you selected. AI explains the result in your device language.

principle.title: AI reads and explains. It never fills the blanks.
principle.body: Unknown stays unknown. Nutrition values are never guessed. Allergens are never marked absent just because the field is empty. The score and its evidence remain visible together.
principle.fact1Body: Open Food Facts or visible package text creates the factual layer. AI cannot add to it.
principle.fact2Body: Goal rules calculate the score before AI writes a single sentence.
principle.fact3Body: You see the exact declared number, classification or ingredient behind each plus or minus.

personal.title: Personal beats generic
personal.body: The same cereal may score well for a high-fiber goal and poorly for someone limiting sugar. Your goals, eating pattern, allergens and avoid list change the explanation — never the underlying facts.

features.title: Made for the supermarket aisle
features.f1Body: Open Food Facts first, with backend caching that respects public API limits.
features.f2Body: Read a complete package label or identify visible food without pretending its hidden ingredients or nutrition are known.
features.f3Body: Update your goals, diet and flagged ingredients any time from Profile.
features.f4Body: Recent product results stay on your device for quick comparison.
features.f5Body: The interface follows the device; explanations request the full device language tag.
features.f6Body: Core barcode lookup and the personal evidence-based score stay free.

pricing.title: Scan every barcode free. Add AI when it helps.
pricing.premiumFeature1: Food and missing-label recognition from photos
pricing.premiumFeature2: Expanded AI conclusion grounded in known facts
pricing.premiumFeature3: Product names, ingredients and findings translated
pricing.note: Monthly and annual store prices are shown in the app before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in store settings.

cta.title: Read the package. Understand the choice.
cta.body: IngreFit is being prepared for iOS and Android. Leave your email to hear when early access opens.

footer.tagline: Personal food clarity, grounded in visible facts.
footer.disclaimer: IngreFit provides general information, not medical advice. Always verify the package for allergies and medical conditions.
footer.off: Product data may come from Open Food Facts, a crowdsourced database whose data is not guaranteed to be complete or accurate.

legal.privacyIntro: Effective August 15, 2026. This policy explains how IngreFit processes information when you use the website and mobile application.
legal.privacyDataBody: Goals, diet preferences and scan history are stored locally by default. The server receives an installation identifier, selected goals, a device language tag and either a barcode, package images or a food photo required for the requested analysis.
legal.privacyImagesBody: Label and food images are sent to the configured AI provider only for the analysis requested by the user. The IngreFit backend processes them during the request and intentionally stores no copies. Package facts are transcribed only from visible text; a food photo identification is marked as uncertain and does not confirm ingredients, allergens or nutrition. Processing by the AI provider is governed by its policy.
legal.privacyThirdBody: The backend may contact Open Food Facts, Google Gemini, hosting and RevenueCat/store billing providers. Their terms and privacy practices also apply.
legal.privacyRightsBody: You can remove local history by clearing application data. Privacy questions and data requests can be sent to support@evsi.store.
legal.termsIntro: Effective August 15, 2026. By using IngreFit, you agree to these terms and the store terms that govern any subscription purchase.
legal.termsInfoBody: Scores and explanations are general product information and are not medical, dietary or professional advice. Users must verify product packaging, especially for allergies or health conditions.
legal.termsDataBody: Open Food Facts is crowdsourced and may be incomplete, outdated or inaccurate. Product packaging is the controlling source.
legal.termsBillingBody: Barcode lookup and the core personal score are free without a daily scan limit. Premium adds photo recognition, translation and an expanded AI conclusion. Store prices are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in App Store or Google Play settings; store refund rules apply.
legal.termsAcceptBody: Do not automate abusive traffic, bypass access controls, probe protected routes, upload unrelated or unlawful images, or interfere with the service.
